name: P0
desc: port 0 (QFP pins 3-10): head strobe lines for band rows 0-7 (bit n = row n); P00-P07 -> TD62593A IC6 -> head connector CN2 pins 18-11 (schematic: RWeick/IF-GBP-02-Gameboy-Printer)

name: P1
desc: port 1 (QFP pins 11-18): head strobe lines for band rows 8-15; P10-P17 -> TD62593A IC5 -> CN2 pins 10-3

name: P2
desc: port 2: bit0 front button SW1 (P20 = INT5 pin 19; 0 = pressed; pull-up R24); bit1 SRAM /WE (P21 pin 21); bit2 SRAM /CE1 (P22 pin 22)

name: P4
desc: port 4: bits 0-4 SRAM address A8-A12 (written OR 0xE0); bits 5-7 SIO2 (P45 SCK2 -> link pin 5, P46 SI2 <- link pin 3, P47 SO2 -> link pin 2)

name: P5
desc: port 5: bit0 encoder (P50 = INT3: motor connector CN1 pin 3 through transistor Q10); bit1 cam sensor (P51 = INT4: CN1 pin 5, pull-up R29); bit2 motor (P52 -> Q8/Q9 -> Q6/Q7 -> CN1 pin 2; 0 = run, 1 = brake); bit3 power hold (P53 -> Q14 -> Q4/Q5: keeps the head supply and LED1 on; the firmware only clears it); bit4 SRAM /OE (P54)

name: P7CR
desc: port 7 direction (0xFF = output for SRAM writes)

name: ADCCR
desc: A/D control: low bits channel (0 = AIN0/P60: thermistor TH1 to GND with 10k pull-up R28 - other error 0x40 outside 0x35-0xD7, strobe base time; 1 = AIN1/P61: battery through divider R26/R27 - low battery 0x80 at 0x7E or below); bit6 start; bit7 end of conversion

name: TREG1A
desc: timer 1 register A (16-bit): strobe tick length in us

name: TREG2
desc: timer 2 register (16-bit): 0x000A = 10.24 ms tick; 0x03D5 = 1.0 s in idle

name: TC4CR
desc: timer 4 control: 0xD0 = start fc/2^11 (inter-byte timeout 5.12 ms); 0xC0 = stop and clear

name: SIO2CR1
desc: serial 2 control 1: 0x67 = stop / 8-bit transmit-receive external clock; 0xA7 = start
